Sam: All-hands is live! Stream link in the top post — waving from my living room :wave: :tada:
Priya: 🎉 woohoo, getting snacks ready. who's bringing popcorn? :popcorn:
Jordan: Me — extra butter. also i demand more slide jokes this quarter :joy:
Maya: Mic test — can everyone hear Sam ok?
Chris: loud and clear here! :speaker_high_volume:
Liam: Sam's hair has peak all-hands energy today, 10/10 :sparkles: :laughing:
Nora: shoutout to infra for the uptime callout — that chart went HARD. :clap::clap:
DevOpsBot: Reminder: please react with :raised_hands: when you want to ask a question — queue will be managed by the hosts.
Priya: @Sam also — ukulele encore? i vote for the two-minute ukulele interlude :guitar_smile:
Zoe: +1 for ukulele. and can we get a snack poll? i'm team pretzel.
Jordan: poll: popcorn / pretzel / cookie / nothing (health) --> what are you eating? :ballot_box:
Maya: cookie. homemade. pls no crumbs on my keyboard :sob:
Sam: Haha love the vibes. quick one: big kudos to Maya for shipping the new onboarding flow — that metric spike was lovely. :sparkles:
Nora: KUDOS Maya!! :trophy: :heart_eyes:
Liam: also shoutout to Chris for the server rescue last night, hero energy :superhero:
Chris: please stop calling me a hero, i have laundry :sweat_smile:
Priya: reaction train: :beer: :confetti_ball: :partying_face:
Jordan: someone post the gif of the corgi taking notes please :dog: :memo:
Zoe: dropping it now -> https://giphy.com/corgi-notes (gif)
Sam: Love the corgi. Also quick reminder — all-hands Q&A at the end, leave questions in thread or raise hand.
Maya: raised hand! question about dedicated capacity quotas — will follow up in product channel after, but wanted to flag now.
DevOpsBot: Note: recording will be available in #all-hands within 10 minutes after the meeting ends.
Priya: tiny poll result so far: popcorn 3, cookie 1, pretzel 1, nothing 0
Jordan: LOL the realtime snack scoreboard is the fewest metrics i've ever cared about but i'm here for it.
Nora: anyone else trying to mime applause because background noise rules apply? :clap::skin-tone-2:
Liam: fake-clapping in the corner of my living room, very professional :laughing:
Zoe: Afterparty plan — casual hang in #random for 15 min post all-hands, bring your favorite GIFs and one weird snack rec.
Sam: Perfect. See you all at the Q&A. Thanks for the energy — love this silly, supportive crew. :heart:
Priya: :heart: :confetti_ball: :popcorn:
